models_evaluated: custom machine learning model predicting Heme-STAMP test results

links.outcome: Model discrimination (AUC) compared with expert hematologist estimates for predicting Heme-STAMP results
links.effect: Model AUC 0.77 [0.66, 0.87] vs hematologists 0.78 [0.68, 0.86]; the model also improved calibration of human estimates.
links.quote: The model predicted the results of a complex next-generation sequencing test with discriminatory power comparable to expert hematologists (AUC score: 0.77 [0.66, 0.87], 0.78 [0.68, 0.86] respectively) and with the capacity to improve the calibration of human estimates.

unlisted_practices: Using ML prediction to guide test-ordering decisions instead of restricting use or applying rule-based criteria
Integrating a custom ML model into a live clinical environment to collect real-time model and physician estimates

screen.reason: Evaluates the prospective real-time integration of a custom ML model into a live clinical workflow to guide physician test-ordering decisions, showing its effect on human estimate calibration.
